steps.text: Hello
It's Ethan
I received your tutoring request earlier today
Thanks for reaching out
I'm looking for someone who can help {{name:hailey}} prepare for her exams
What students do you usually work with?
I mainly work with high school and college students
Perfect
And my goal isn't just to explain lessons
I also help students build study habits and stay focused
That sounds like exactly what she needs
I usually start by identifying the subjects causing the most trouble
Then we create a study plan and work through it step by step
She's capable of doing well, but...
She just struggles to stay motivated sometimes
That's very common
Most students are more capable than they think
They just need structure and consistency
When would you be available?
Tomorrow afternoon would work for me
I can come by, meet her and evaluate where she currently stands
Perfect
I'll let her know
Great
Feel free to message me if you have any questions before then
